headline: Long-read methylation mapping paired with transposable element and SV genotyping
label: Long Read Methylation Variant Profiling
summary: Long-read data now supports sample-specific CpG methylation calls and polymorphic transposable element annotation within unified analysis pipelines.
synthesis: The dominant thread in these items is the use of long-read sequencing to resolve epigenetic and structural variation at the level of individual samples. The published bsseq framework applies a read-based likelihood model to Nanopore and PacBio data to identify sample-specific CpG loci and assess their epigenetic modifications. GraffiTE v1.1, a Nextflow pipeline, combines structural variant genotyping and polymorphic transposable element annotation with long-read methylation mapping in one workflow. ADZE 2.0 is a population-genetic tool that extends rarefaction-based allelic and private allelic richness to read VCF data, with genome-wide or windowed statistics; it is included for its variant-data scope rather than its epigenetic content. What is new is the joint treatment of methylation and genotype information from long reads within a single analytic frame.
